text.en: Killing four or more combatants in a single volley increases the damage of the next volley.
Killing four or more combatants in a single volley increases the damage of the next volley.

Scoring 4 kills in a single volley grants 'Adaptive Ordnance' and generates one ammo out of thin air into your reserves.

Adaptive Ordnance grants 50% increased damage to your next volley.
